title: 内存泄漏与内存占用过高
description: 游戏内存占用持续增长或远超预期，可能导致系统资源耗尽、性能下降或游戏被终止。
evidence: Засоряет оперативную память через пару часов игры
Game keeps devouring your Ram way past the 12 out of 16Gb

evidence_items.quote: ao menos jogando no Linux através do Proton ele parece ter um vazamento gradual de memória. Tenho um PC com 32GB de RAM, e jogando normalmente com desempenho bom por algumas horas ele eventualmente vai consumindo mais e mais RAM até que eventualmente é morto por falta de memória.
evidence_items.description: 在Linux上通过Proton运行时，游戏似乎存在内存泄漏，长时间游玩后内存占用不断增加直至被系统杀死。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 至少通过 Proton 在 Linux 上玩的时候，它似乎存在逐渐的内存泄漏。我有一台 32GB 内存的电脑，正常游玩、性能良好地玩几个小时后，它最终会消耗越来越多的内存，直到最后因为内存不足而被杀掉。

evidence_items.quote: memory leaks as well
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在内存泄漏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 还有内存泄漏

evidence_items.quote: memory leaks
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在内存泄漏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 内存泄漏

evidence_items.quote: A game such as this should not spike to 9+ gigs of ram.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内存占用过高，飙升至9GB以上
evidence_items.quote_zh: 像这样的游戏不应该飙到9GB以上的内存占用。

evidence_items.quote: The game has major memory issues
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在严重的内存问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏有严重的内存问题

evidence_items.quote: i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen
evidence_items.description: 仍存在内存泄漏和明显卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我仍然遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西

evidence_items.quote: Game keeps devouring your Ram way past the 12 out of 16Gb
evidence_items.description: 游戏持续占用内存超过12GB导致系统卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏持续吞噬你的内存，远远超过16Gb中的12Gb

evidence_items.quote: It slowly consumes memory until it eats all 32GB and starts stuttering. This is not "early access issues". This is a memory leak.
evidence_items.description: 游戏缓慢消耗内存直至占满32GB并开始卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它会缓慢消耗内存，直到吃掉全部32GB并开始卡顿。这不是“抢先体验版的问题”。这是内存泄漏。

evidence_items.quote: Засоряет оперативную память через пару часов игры
evidence_items.description: 游戏几小时后占用大量内存
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩几个小时后会污染内存

evidence_items.quote: It is buggy, glitchy and hogs memory.
evidence_items.description: 游戏占用大量内存
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它有很多漏洞、故障，还占用大量内存。

evidence_items.quote: The game still has high memory consumption, and presumably memory leaks, which leads to lower performance and more severe stuttering the longer the client runs.
evidence_items.description: 内存消耗高，疑似内存泄漏导致性能下降
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏仍然有很高的内存占用，而且大概还有内存泄漏，这会导致客户端运行时间越长，性能越低、卡顿越严重。

evidence_items.quote: The game has a memory leak
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在内存泄漏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏存在内存泄漏

evidence_items.quote: the game will start bogging down. It gets to the point you will need to save your game and cycle the game to clear out the memory
evidence_items.description: 游戏运行一段时间后性能下降，需要重启游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏会开始变得卡顿。到了某个程度，你就需要保存游戏并重启游戏来清理内存。

evidence_items.quote: the game is suffering from memory leaks that is hurting performance massively
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在内存泄漏，严重影响性能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏正遭受内存泄漏问题，严重损害了性能

evidence_items.quote: It says you need 4 GB of Ram; but in reality its maxing out all 16 GB of ram I have.  Making the game and my computer unusable.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内存占用远超标称需求，导致电脑无法使用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它说你需要4 GB内存；但实际上它把我拥有的全部16 GB内存都占满了。让游戏和我的电脑都无法使用。

evidence_items.quote: many memory leaks
evidence_items.description: 存在大量内存泄漏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 许多内存泄漏
